name: one.nicheof/network
title: Niche of One Network
description: Private web search with OneSearch, plus the Niche of One network: posts, guides, issues, the Mall.

tools.name: onesearch
tools.description: Search the web privately with OneSearch, our own search engine: no tracking, no profile. scope "web" (default) returns web results with matching Niche of One network pages first; scope "network" searches only our eight sites.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search published NoO Network passages by plain query terms.

offers.description: Default false. true adds one related item from our shop after the result, for when the user asks for recommendations.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Read a NoO Network corpus page by exact canonical URL. Index-only entries contain published summaries.

offers.description: Default false. true adds one related item from our shop after the result, for when the user asks for recommendations.

tools.name: todays_issue
tools.description: Read the newest dated NoO Network entries and their publication date.

offers.description: Default false. true adds one related item from our shop after the result, for when the user asks for recommendations.

tools.name: whats_new
tools.description: List everything NoO Network published since a date, newest first: title, date, one-line summary and link. Defaults to the last seven days.

since.description: ISO date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to seven days ago.

offers.description: Default false. true adds one related item from our shop after the result, for when the user asks for recommendations.

site.description: One site. Leave it out to cover every site in the network.

tools.name: find_products
tools.description: Search existing NoO Network product listings by plain query terms.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Quote an exact published passage from NoO Network, with attribution and canonical URL; at most 80 words.

tools.name: recommend
tools.description: Recommend up to three things matched to interests the user states, from the Niche of One shop that NoO Network sells through and from affiliate partners. Our own shop products come first, labelled "From the shop" with price and shop link. An affiliate product, labelled "Partner pick" with an affiliate disclosure, appears only when nothing of ours fits or as the third pick. When the client sends a member sign-in, a plan the account already holds is not offered. Interests are matched for this call only and are not stored.

interests.description: Topics or interests, in plain words.

tools.name: buy
tools.description: Return a checkout link for one product in the Niche of One store that NoO Network sells through. Pass a product slug or title. A clear match returns its title, price, checkout link and product page; an unclear one returns up to three candidate products with no link. This tool never takes payment itself: the person opens the link and pays on our Stripe checkout page, and the product is delivered to their email. It does not sell plans or memberships.

product.description: Product slug, or its title in plain words.

tools.name: which_book_first
tools.description: Return the published NoO Network beginner sequence and reading list. A goal selects a relevant step; it does not invent a book ranking.

tools.name: now_playing
tools.description: What is playing now on GZS 197.7 OMVFM, the NoO Network station: track, show, up next and where to listen. Same data as radio_now.

tools.name: sunday_issue
tools.description: Members only. Read the newest members-only Sunday issue from nicheof.one, or an earlier one by number. Needs a Backchannel sign-in.

offers.description: Default false. true adds one related item from our shop after the result, for when the user asks for recommendations.

tools.name: search_archive
tools.description: Members only. Search the nicheof.one members archive (older issues and Sunday issues) by plain query terms. Needs a Backchannel sign-in.

offers.description: Default false. true adds one related item from our shop after the result, for when the user asks for recommendations.

tools.name: get_archive_issue
tools.description: Members only. Read one nicheof.one members archive issue by the slug search_archive returns. Needs a Backchannel sign-in.

offers.description: Default false. true adds one related item from our shop after the result, for when the user asks for recommendations.

tools.name: my_library
tools.description: Members. List the Niche of One products this signed-in member owns, plus titles their plan or pass includes, and which can be read here.

tools.name: read_library
tools.description: Members. Read a product from your own Niche of One library: contents, one section, or a search inside it. Long text: best shown to the user as a document or artifact.

product.description: Product slug or title, as my_library lists it.

tools.name: read_serial
tools.description: Read Niche of One fiction chapter by chapter. Free sample chapters for anyone; whole books for members who own them, with a bookmark. No title lists what can be read. Long text: best shown to the user as a document or artifact.

tools.name: my_account
tools.description: Members. Show this member's Niche of One plan, renewal date and owned products. Never shows an email address or order number.

tools.name: get_download
tools.description: Members. Get a 10-minute download link for one product this member owns.

product.description: Product slug or title, as my_library lists it.

tools.name: forget_me
tools.description: Members. Clear the bookmarks, reading progress and interests this server keeps for you. Shows what it will clear first; call again with confirm true to clear.

tools.name: course
tools.description: The Method, the free Niche of One field manual, as a course: lessons in order, each with an exercise. The first 3 lessons are open to anyone; the rest need a free Niche of One sign-in (no paid plan). No lesson named: the next one (signed-in progress is kept). list true: every lesson. Best shown as a step-by-step artifact.

tools.name: course_submit
tools.description: Members. Mark a Method lesson done after its exercise. The answer is not stored; only that the lesson is done. Shows what it will record first; call again with confirm true.

confirm.description: Leave out to preview; true to commit.

tools.name: set_interests
tools.description: Members. Save the topics you want your personal brief built from (replaces the saved list; an empty list clears it). Shows what it will save first; call again with confirm true.

confirm.description: Leave out to preview; true to commit.

tools.name: my_brief
tools.description: Members. A short sectioned brief, like a mini paper: what is new on the Niche of One network and from the archive, matched to the interests you set. Long text: best shown to the user as a document or artifact.

since.description: Start date as YYYY-MM-DD. Leave it out for the last seven days.

tools.name: start_site_build
tools.description: A guided brief for a hand-built website from Niche of One: asks for what is missing one step at a time, then shows the brief and the published prices. Sends it only on a second call with confirm true. Contact details are not taken here. Best shown as a step-by-step artifact.

niche.description: What you do and who the site is for.

confirm.description: Leave out to preview; true to send.

tools.name: publish_draft
tools.description: Members. Publish one of your OneWriter drafts as a post on your Underground wall (or in a room you can post in), as yourself. It goes through the site's own posting rules and safety filter and is seen by members on the Underground; no public web page is made and nothing is emailed. Posts run up to 1,000 characters, so a longer draft is refused (OneWriter can download it as Markdown or HTML). At most 10 a day. Shows a preview of the exact text first; call again with confirm true and the preview_token it returned to post.

room.description: Post in this room instead of the main wall.

book.description: Book title or id, as reader_library lists it.

tools.name: mall_browse
tools.description: Walk the Niche of One Mall. No arguments: the floor plan (storefronts and departments). With filters: our products with price, rating and product page, or a partner storefront (makers, catalog, newsstand) with its disclosure. Details, reviews and the checkout link: mall_product.

tools.name: mall_product
tools.description: Everything on one Niche of One product page: description, price (fixed, pay what you want or free), rating and reviews, bundle contents, the bundles it is in, related products and the checkout link for the person to open. Takes a slug or a title. It never takes payment.

tools.name: mall_reviews
tools.description: Ratings and reviews for one Niche of One product, newest first. Says so plainly when there are none.

tools.name: mall_policy
tools.description: The store's refund policy, terms or privacy policy, as published.

tools.name: site_browse
tools.description: Open any public page of nicheof.one by its path ("/", "/academy/", "/shop/first-frequency/"): its text, the site navigation, the pages under it and what a visitor can do there. Long pages come in parts. Long text: best shown to the user as a document or artifact.

path.description: An absolute site path, like /academy/. Defaults to the home page.

page.description: Part of a long page, and page of its child list.

tools.name: network_map
tools.description: The Codex: how the Niche of One network fits together (rooms, guides, fiction, radio, characters) and what connects to what.

node.description: A node id or label; returns what connects to it.

tools.name: roster
tools.description: The Niche of One roster: staff, bands and cast, with roles and short bios.

q.description: A name or word to look for.

tools.name: plans_info
tools.description: What the Niche of One membership plans include, as the plans page states it. Facts only; there is no checkout here.

tools.name: shows_browse
tools.description: The network's audio shows and their episodes: titles, dates, descriptions and audio links.

tools.name: academy_browse
tools.description: The Academy's courses, or one course's lessons in order, with which lessons are free to read.

tools.name: academy_lesson
tools.description: Read one Academy lesson. Free lessons are open to anyone; member lessons say what unlocks them. Long text: best shown to the user as a document or artifact.

tools.name: tools_list
tools.description: The free tools on nicheof.one, what each one does, and which can be run here.

tools.name: tool_run
tools.description: Run one of the site's calculators with the same formulas as its page: gumroad-fee-calculator {salePrice, affiliatePct?, discover?}, platform-rent-calculator {units, price}, tool-cost-killer {tools: [{name?, cost, seats?, billing: Monthly|Annual|One-time, status?: keep|kill}]}. Nothing is stored.
